plan_review.notes: Separate-model plan review before coding. It found one blocker: an internal Floor 4 VICTORY phase would not terminate headless runs unless the runner consumed a terminal scenario outcome; implemented by checking scenario.getRunOutcome(world) generically. It also flagged two non-blocking requirements: update lastWorldElapsedMs every tick so held intermission time cannot leak into arenaElapsedMs, and document the slice-2 auto-intermission deviation; both were implemented and covered by tests/spec/ADR.

rounds.notes: Found default Floor 4 headless runs stalled at the 600s quest watchdog before the ~608s rehearsal victory because the test disabled questStallFrames. Fixed by making the headless progress score use floor4Arena arenaElapsedMs/timeline progress when present and by restoring the test to default watchdog settings.

Re-review verified the default Floor 4 headless path reaches victory with floor4Arena.phase=VICTORY and arenaElapsedMs=600000. Runtime correctness, determinism, wiring, and security were clean; only the in-progress ledger artifact remained to complete.
